title: Promote and roll back recipes via an immutable version pointer
narrative: Recipe execution policies are versioned, testable, replaceable artifacts with a reversible promotion pointer — not only class version fields and demotion stamps. Incubation stamps exist in `fangore_insp_template_incubation`; lineage and evaluation attachments are in `fangore_insp_recipe_lineage_promote`. Tracks MH-SR-01[^insp-sr-01].
implementation: `GraphTemplateRegistry` stores every version of a catalog id (here `verify_repair`): `add_version` registers an immutable inactive candidate, `promote(name, version)` moves the active pointer, `rollback(name)` restores the previous target, and `get(name, version=...)` reads any stored version. `register` keeps legacy activate-by-name semantics. Eval results and promotion policy stay host/June-owned.
validation: Harness `cli` `recipe_plan` loads `plans/*.yaml` (human-readable lifecycle plan); hard expects on declared observation keys.
